name: Webhook to structured JSON with Gaffa

parameters.content:
## Webhook to structured JSON

### How it works
POST a URL and a list of fields, get back structured JSON pulled from that page.

1. The Webhook receives a JSON body with `url`, a `fields` list, and an optional `selector`.
2. The Build request node turns your field list into a Gaffa parse_json request.
3. The Gaffa node loads the page in a real browser and extracts the fields.
4. Respond to Webhook returns the extracted object.

### Setup
1. Install the Gaffa community node (@gaffa-dev/n8n-nodes-gaffa) if you have not already.
2. Create an API key at gaffa.dev and add it as the Gaffa API credential.
3. Activate the workflow and POST to the webhook URL.

### Request body
```
{
  "url": "https://example.com/product",
  "selector": "main",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "title", "type": "string", "description": "The product title" },
    { "name": "price", "type": "string", "description": "The listed price" }
  ]
}
```

### Customization tips
The selector is optional, on large pages point it at the region holding the data so the extraction stays focused. Add or remove fields per request, no workflow change needed.
